en-UK.name: Tavern Plugin Interface
en-UK.description: Download, convert and run third-party tavern-style plugins.
en-UK.description_markdown: **Tavern Plugin Interface** — a host + conversion layer: download third-party tavern-style plugins, convert their runtime expectations, and run them inside beilu. Incompatible plugins report exactly which interfaces are missing instead of failing silently.
en-UK.author: 凛倾

zh-CN.name: 酒馆插件接口
zh-CN.description: 下载、转移并运行酒馆系第三方插件
zh-CN.description_markdown: **酒馆插件接口** — 宿主 + 转移层：下载酒馆系第三方插件，经转移适配后在 beilu 内运行。不兼容的插件会明确列出缺哪个接入面，而不是静默失败。
zh-CN.author: 凛倾
